description: Multi-turn agent sessions over synthetic sandboxes with exact, checkable answers. Turn 1 is the main task, turn 2 a recall probe about an early detail, turns 3-4 follow-ups.

turns.question:
Audit the storefront platform in this sandbox. There are 8 service modules under services/ and each defines a SERVICE_CONFIG dict. Read every one of them: a value you have not read is unknown. Use SERVICE_CONFIG values (changelog comments are history, not config).
1. List every service whose timeout_ms is greater than 2000, with its owner.
2. Give the total max_connections over all services whose region is "eu-west".
3. Among services whose depends_on includes "auth", which one has the most retries?
Finish with a JSON object of exactly this form:
{"slow_services": {"<service>": "<owner>"}, "eu_west_max_connections": <int>, "most_retries_auth_dependent": "<service>"}
One more question about the audit: what port does the auth service listen on, and which services does it depend on? Answer with JSON: {"port": <int>, "depends_on": ["<service>"]}
Which owner team owns the most services, and how many does it own? Answer with JSON: {"team": "<owner>", "count": <int>}
List every service in region "eu-west" whose max_connections is at least 150. Answer with JSON: {"services": ["<service>"]}
